verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms BigCommerce has REST and GraphQL APIs (bigcommerce-docs-4, bigcommerce-docs-25) but nothing in the pack documents API versioning schemes or a deprecation policy/timeline for breaking changes. Community comments even note unreliable API connectivity (bigcommerce-comm-4), but that's about reliability, not versioning policy. missing for 10: documented API version numbering scheme, deprecation notice timelines, sunset/EOL policy for old API versions.
